text:
mia: heads up — alert delivery to #oncall is failing, started ~08:24 UTC. customers reporting missing pages. see notifyflow errors (504) in infra logs :rotating_light:
notifyflow: ALERT 2026-03-19T08:24:32Z — webhook POST /v2/notify -> 504 Gateway Timeout (x-retries=3) — queued=42
sam: ack, i'm on it. what changed around that time? any deploys?
ops-bot: deploy: service/notifyflow v2.3.7 -> v2.3.8 by @ci (08:18 UTC) :hammer_and_wrench:
lucas: i rolled signing-key rotation config at 08:17 for rotate-proxy. pushing note: proxy now validates signature version v2 only.
maya: support reported a customer (AcmeCorp) missed 3 alerts and called support. they said they didn't receive SMS nor slack pings. ticket created: INC-4821.
tim: oncall stepping in. timeline: 08:17 key rotation, 08:18 deploy, 08:24 alert flood. suspicion: new proxy signature strictness + new notifyflow client changes.
sam: can someone paste recent notifyflow request/response headers? need to see signature header and proxy response.
lucas: grabbing logs now — excerpt below:
```
[08:23:58] POST /v2/notify headers: X-Signature: v1=abcd1234, X-Sig-Version: 1
[08:24:01] proxy -> 504 upstream read timeout (verify signature v2 required)
[08:24:03] notifyflow retry 1 -> same 504
```
mia: confirms — client is still sending v1 signature while proxy expects v2. why did rotation not accept v1 fallback?
lucas: rotation script was supposed to accept both for 1h but the deploy changed the validation flag. my bad, deploy removed fallback flag in haste.
sam: for mitigation: two options — revert the deploy or flip proxy validation to accept v1. which is faster?
ops-bot: revert candidate available: service/notifyflow v2.3.7 (08:18) — revert takes ~6m with healthchecks. flip on proxy is config change and should be immediate if we unfreeze validation flag.
tim: do config flip first (less blast radius). sam, lucas — please coordinate. i'll take customer comms.
lucas: flipping proxy validation now to accept v1 and v2. running: `kubectl set env deploy/proxy VALIDATE_SIG_V2_ONLY=false -n infra`
notifyflow: action: received config update -> proxy validation accepted signatures v1,v2. previously queued deliveries: 42. retrying now.
maya: AcmeCorp says they just got a delayed alert; one message arrived at 08:31. they're asking for root cause ETA.
sam: verified delivery backlog draining; token delivery rate back to normal. can we confirm no other code paths break if we re-enable fallback?
lucas: quick check: no dependent services require v2-only. patch noted. i'll add a strict guard in the rollout pipeline and mark the deploy as rollback-blocked until we add an explicit migration window.
mia: customer impact: partial (several customers saw delayed or missing alerts for ~7-12 minutes). no confirmed production data loss but missed notifications for oncall workflows. severity set to Sev2.
sam: creating incident issue INC-4821 with notes and timeline. assigning postmortem to lucas + sam.
ops-bot: incident ticket INC-4821 created (https://tracker/INC-4821) — severity=SEV2, assignees=lucas,sam, target-retro=2026-03-21
maya: support will send templated update to affected customers: "We identified an issue with signature rotation and alert delivery; mitigation applied and deliveries resumed. Full postmortem pending."
tim: live mitigation done. owners: lucas (infra change), sam (notifyflow rollback/patch), mia (customer comms). action items:
- lucas: add deployment gate to prevent removing fallback without migration flag (ETA 48h)
- sam: add watchdog that alerts if queued deliveries > 20 for >5m (ETA 24h)
- mia/maya: customer follow-up pack and affected list (ETA 8h)
- runbook update: document signature rotation steps and verification checklist (owner: sam, ETA 72h)

sam: quick logs attached for timeline and curl used to test fallback:
```
curl -v -X POST https://proxy.internal/v2/notify -H "X-Signature: v1=abcd1234" -d '{"event":"test"}'
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```
maya: added customer notes to INC-4821 with AcmeCorp contact.
lucas: pushing hotfix to prevent config flag removal from future deploys. will follow up in the postmortem with diff.
notifyflow: INFO: backlog drained to 0 at 08:34. average retry delay 5s.
mia: thanks all. we should keep channel open for 1h for follow-ups. please react :eyes: to confirm ownership of your action items.
sam: :eyes:
lucas: :eyes:
maya: :eyes:
